description: A session's recap: full, short and spoiler-free summaries, key events, highlights with quotes, NPCs, monsters, locations, spells, items, factions and character actions. Actions include entry IDs, summary, interaction text and complete interaction_links for chargen_edit_recap_entry. DM notes are visible only to the campaign owner. Pass 'version' for recap history; omit for the latest.
name: chargen_get_session_recap
title: Get session recap
